# has goal

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasGoal`](gmeow-hasGoal.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasGoal>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Flat shortcut: the agent holds this goal, commitment grade unspecified. The 80% case ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)); promote to a [`Desire`](../classes/gmeow-Desire.md) / [`Intention`](../classes/gmeow-Intention.md) / [`Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md) when the grade matters, and to an [`IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) when adoption or revision over time is itself the fact of interest. Whether avowed by the agent or attributed by an observer rides [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) on the statement.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> [`gmeow:Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasGoal`](gmeow-hasGoal.md) from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to [`gmeow:Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Goal And Intention

- **Source:** [`slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-teleology-examples-goal-and-intention)#example-slices-core-teleology-examples-goal-and-intention

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: goals, intentions, and commitments. GMEOW separates the
# intentional moments gUFO keeps distinct: a gmeow:Goal is the SocialObject an
# agent aims at (gmeow:hasGoal); a gmeow:Intention is an intentional MODE borne by
# an agent that aims at that goal (gmeow:intentionGoal) and MOTIVATES concrete
# action (gmeow:motivates → an Event); a gmeow:Commitment is a relator binding a
# committed agent to a beneficiary. The desire-to / intend-to / commit-to layers
# are not collapsed — each is its own first-class moment.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/teleology/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

ex:dana a gmeow:Person ;
    gmeow:name    "Dana Reyes"@en ;
    gmeow:hasGoal ex:degreeGoal .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the 80% case ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)): an agent holds a goal and neither the commitment grade nor its tenure over time needs to be first-class — the flat half of the [`gmeow:hasGoal`](gmeow-hasGoal.md) ↔ [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) pair.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the commitment grade matters (promote to [`gmeow:Desire`](../classes/gmeow-Desire.md) / [`gmeow:Intention`](../classes/gmeow-Intention.md) / [`gmeow:Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md)) or when adoption and revision over time is itself the fact (promote to [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md)); attribution vs avowal rides [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md), not a separate property.

### How to use

- Assert the flat statement from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to [`gmeow:Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md); carry a simple validity window on the statement with [`gmeow:validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md), and reify to a mode or an [`IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) only when grade, tenure, or standpoint must become first-class.
